decisions.choice: my food: the offerings pictured as a meal at God's table
decisions.reason: The offerings are called God's food, as in Leviticus 3:11 and 21:6, a picture of gifts set before a king at his table. It does not mean that God needs to be fed: Psalm 50:12-13 says plainly that he does not. The picture shows that these gifts belong to him and are received by him.

decisions.choice: my offerings by fire, my aroma of soothing: gifts burned on the altar that God gladly accepts
decisions.reason: For the offering by fire see 15:3: a gift burned, wholly or in part, on the altar. The smoke is pictured as a smell that calms and pleases God, so that he accepts the people who bring it (Genesis 8:21; Leviticus 1:9).

decisions.choice: you shall take care ... at its appointed time: each offering on its fixed day, a duty of the whole people
decisions.reason: "You" is plural: the whole people are responsible that the offerings are never left off or brought at the wrong time. "Its appointed time" uses the word for the festivals (Leviticus 23:2, 4). Leviticus 23 gave the dates of the festivals; chapters 28-29 give the offerings for each of them (Leviticus 23:37).

decisions.choice: food offerings
decisions.reason: As in 15:3, Balanced and Readable say "food offering", and Readable adds "burned on the altar". Literal keeps "offerings by fire". Balanced keeps "food" and "food offerings" side by side, as the Hebrew puts them.

decisions.choice: Be careful to present ... / Be sure to bring ...
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the offerings first and puts the command at the end. Balanced and Readable put the command first, so that the sentence is easy to follow. Readable makes the description of the offerings a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "thức ăn của Ta"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is "bread" in the sense of food; "thức ăn" gives the picture of a meal at God's table without suggesting baked bread only.

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng bằng lửa" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for the offering by fire, kept apart from the burnt offering ("của lễ thiêu").

decisions.choice: "불로 바치는 제물" (Literal, Balanced), "제단에서 불로 태워 바치는 제물" (Readable) for the offering by fire; "향기로운 냄새" (Literal, Balanced), "기뻐하는 향기" (Readable) for the soothing aroma
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch term sheet words, as in Korean Leviticus. The short traditional term "화제" is not used, so that new readers see what the offering is.

decisions.choice: "나의 음식" for "my food" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision explains the picture of a meal at God's table; Korean keeps the picture plainly rather than turning it into "제물".

decisions.choice: o meu alimento; as minhas ofertas queimadas (L, B), ofertas queimadas no fogo (R); aroma agradável (L, B), o cheiro delas me agrada (R)
decisions.reason: For chapters 28-29, with the terms of Leviticus 1:9 (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): the gift on the altar fire is "oferta queimada" (Readable "oferta queimada no fogo"), and the phrase of m2 is "aroma agradável", which Readable turns into "o cheiro ... agrada", as Leviticus Readable does. "O meu alimento" keeps the picture of a meal at God's table (m1); the meaning note, not the wording, says that God does not need food. The commands are plural, "vocês", since the whole people is responsible (m3).

decisions.choice: "በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት" (offering by fire) at every level, Readable adding "በመሠዊያው ላይ" (on the altar); "ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ" (soothing aroma), at Readable "መዓዛው … ደስ ያሰኛል"; "መባ" for the offering (qorban)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms list gives "በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት" for this word; "ምግቤ" (my food) already stands beside it in this verse, so the English Balanced "food offering" is not repeated. These formulas recur word for word through chapters 28 and 29.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (L, B) and "እስራኤላውያን" (R) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already includes daughters, so Amharic has no second wording for the English gender span.

records.literal_gloss: And you will say to them, this [is] the offering by fire which you will present to Yahweh: lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, two for the day, [a] burnt offering continually.

en.L: And you shall say to them, 'This [is] the offering by fire which you shall present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: male lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, two each day, a continual burnt offering.
en.B: Tell them: 'Each day you are to present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as a food offering, two year-old male lambs without defect. This is the regular burnt offering.
en.R: Tell them: 'Here is the food offering burned on the altar that you must bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Every day bring two male lambs one year old, with nothing wrong with them. Offer them as a burnt offering every day without fail.

es.L: Y les dirás: “Esta [es] la ofrenda quemada que {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: corderos de un año, sin defecto, dos cada día, en holocausto continuo.
es.B: Diles: “Cada día {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como ofrenda quemada, dos corderos de un año, sin defecto. Es el holocausto regular.
es.R: Diles: “Esta es la ofrenda quemada en el altar que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} traer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Cada día {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} dos corderos de un año, que no tengan ningún defecto. {{plural_you:Ofrézcanlos|Ofrecedlos}} como holocausto cada día, sin falta.

fr.L: Et tu leur diras : “Voici l’offrande consumée par le feu que vous présenterez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : des agneaux d’un an, sans défaut, deux par jour, en holocauste continuel.
fr.B: Dis-leur : “Chaque jour, vous présenterez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, en offrande consumée par le feu, deux agneaux d’un an, sans défaut. C’est l’holocauste régulier.
fr.R: Dis-leur : “Voici l’offrande brûlée sur l’autel que vous devez apporter {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Chaque jour, apportez deux agneaux d’un an, sans aucun défaut. Offrez-les en holocauste chaque jour, sans jamais y manquer.

sw.L: Nawe utawaambia, 'Hii [ndiyo] sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto mtakayomsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: wanakondoo dume, wana wa mwaka mmoja, wasio na kasoro, wawili kila siku, sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya daima.
sw.B: Uwaambie, 'Kila siku mtamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, wanakondoo dume wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na kasoro. Hii ndiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku.
sw.R: Uwaambie, 'Hii ndiyo sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto juu ya madhabahu ambayo lazima mmletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kila siku leteni wanakondoo dume wawili wa mwaka mmoja, wasio na kasoro yoyote. Watoeni kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa kila siku bila kukosa.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải nói với họ: 'Đây [là] của lễ dâng bằng lửa mà các ngươi phải dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: chiên con đực một tuổi, không tì vết, mỗi ngày hai con, làm của lễ thiêu thường xuyên.
vi.B: Hãy bảo họ: 'Mỗi ngày các ngươi phải dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hai chiên con đực một tuổi không tì vết làm của lễ dâng bằng lửa. Đó là của lễ thiêu thường xuyên.
vi.R: Hãy bảo họ: 'Đây là của lễ dâng bằng lửa trên bàn thờ mà các ngươi phải đem đến cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Mỗi ngày hãy đem đến hai chiên con đực một tuổi, không có tật gì. Hãy dâng chúng làm của lễ thiêu mỗi ngày, không bỏ sót ngày nào.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 그들에게 일러라. '너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바칠 불로 바치는 제물은 이러하다. 흠 없는 일 년 된 어린 숫양을 날마다 두 마리씩, 늘 드리는 번제로 [바쳐라].
ko.B: 그들에게 이렇게 일러라. '너희는 날마다 일 년 된 흠 없는 어린 숫양 두 마리를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물로 바쳐라. 이것이 늘 드리는 번제이다.
ko.R: 그들에게 이렇게 전하여라. '너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바쳐야 할, 제단에서 불로 태워 바치는 제물은 이러하다. 날마다 일 년 된 어린 숫양 두 마리를 가져와야 한다. 그 양들은 흠이 없어야 한다. 그것을 하루도 빠짐없이 날마다 번제로 바쳐야 한다.

pt.L: E lhes dirás: 'Esta [é] a oferta queimada que vocês apresentarão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: cordeiros, filhos de um ano, sem defeito, dois por dia, [como] holocausto contínuo.
pt.B: Diz-lhes: 'Todos os dias vocês apresentarão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, como oferta queimada, dois cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito. Esse é o holocausto contínuo.
pt.R: Diz a eles: 'Esta é a oferta queimada no fogo que vocês devem trazer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Todos os dias, tragam dois cordeiros machos de um ano, sem nenhum defeito. Ofereçam esses cordeiros como holocausto todos os dias, sem falta.

am.L: እንዲህም በላቸው፦ “{{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የምታቀርቡት በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ይህ ነው፤ የዓመት ልጆች የሆኑ ነውር የሌለባቸው ጠቦቶች፣ በየቀኑ ሁለት፣ የዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት።
am.B: እንዲህም በላቸው፦ “በየቀኑ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት ተባዕት ጠቦቶች {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አቅርቡ። ይህ የዘወትሩ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው።
am.R: እንዲህም በላቸው፦ “{{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳት የምታቀርቡት መሥዋዕት ይህ ነው፦ በየቀኑ አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን ምንም ጉድለት የሌለባቸውን ሁለት ተባዕት ጠቦቶች አምጡ። በየቀኑ ሳታቋርጡ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ አቅርቧቸው።

decisions.choice: continually: regularly, every day without a break
decisions.reason: The word means constant or regular. Used of an offering, it means one that is brought every day and never left off. The daily burnt offering was first commanded in Exodus 29:38-42, and the same word marks it there.

decisions.choice: sons of a year, unblemished: one year old, with no defect
decisions.reason: "Son of a year" means an animal in its first year (Exodus 12:5; Leviticus 23:12). An offering had to be whole and sound, with no injury or flaw (Leviticus 22:19-22).

decisions.choice: and you shall say to them: Moses is to pass on the list that follows
decisions.reason: God now gives Moses the words to say to the people. The list runs from here to the end of chapter 29. The calendar starts with the daily offering, since every other offering in it is added to this one (verses 10, 15, 23, 24, 31).

decisions.choice: regular burnt offering / every day without fail
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "continual". Balanced says "regular", as in Exodus 29:42. Readable says what the word means: an offering brought every day without fail.

decisions.choice: "của lễ thiêu thường xuyên"
decisions.reason: As Exodus 29:42: the offering is made every day without a break.

decisions.choice: "chiên con đực một tuổi"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons of a year" is the ordinary way of giving an animal's age; Vietnamese says it with "một tuổi" at every level, as in Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "늘 드리는 번제" (Literal, Balanced), "하루도 빠짐없이 날마다" (Readable) for the continual burnt offering
decisions.reason: As Korean Exodus 29:38-42; the word means regularly, every day without a break (meaning decision). "상번제" is the older term and is not used.

decisions.choice: o holocausto contínuo (L, B); o holocausto diário, todos os dias, sem falta (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the offering brought every day without a break (m1) is "o holocausto contínuo" at Literal and Balanced, the name it keeps through chapters 28-29, where Balanced repeats it in every day's list; Exodus 29:42 says "diário" there at Balanced, but here the phrase is a fixed name, and "contínuo" says plainly that it never stops. Readable says "o holocausto diário" and here "todos os dias, sem falta", as the English Readable says "daily" and "every day without fail". "Sem defeito" (L, B) and "sem nenhum defeito" (R) are the words of Leviticus 1:3.

decisions.choice: cordeiros, filhos de um ano (L); cordeiros de um ano (B), cordeiros machos de um ano (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "sons of a year" (m2), as Exodus 29:38 does in Portuguese; Balanced says "de um ano". Readable says "machos" where the English Readable says "male lambs", as Leviticus 23:12 does; "cordeiro" names a young sheep of either sex.

decisions.choice: "የዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት" (continual burnt offering, L, B), "ዕለታዊው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት" / "በየቀኑ" (daily, R); "ጠቦቶች" (L), "ተባዕት ጠቦቶች" (male lambs, B, R); "ነውር የሌለባቸው" (L, B), "ምንም ጉድለት የሌለባቸው" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Amharic Exodus 29:38-42, where the same daily offering is first commanded. The Hebrew noun means a young male sheep, which Balanced and Readable say outright as the English does. The same words serve every feast in chapters 28 and 29.

source.text: אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽעַרְבָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: The lamb, one, you will offer in the morning, and the lamb, the second, you will offer between the evenings.

en.L: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer between the two evenings.
en.B: One lamb is to be offered in the morning, and the other as evening comes on.
en.R: Offer one of them in the morning and one in the evening.

es.L: Uno de los corderos lo ofrecerás por la mañana, y el segundo cordero lo ofrecerás entre las dos tardes.
es.B: Un cordero lo ofrecerás por la mañana, y el otro al caer la tarde.
es.R: Ofrece uno de ellos por la mañana y el otro por la tarde.

fr.L: L’un des agneaux, tu l’offriras le matin, et le second agneau, tu l’offriras entre les deux soirs.
fr.B: Tu offriras un agneau le matin, et l’autre à la tombée du soir.
fr.R: Offre l’un d’eux le matin et l’autre le soir.

sw.L: Mwanakondoo mmoja utamtoa asubuhi, na mwanakondoo wa pili utamtoa kati ya jioni mbili.
sw.B: Mwanakondoo mmoja utamtoa asubuhi, na yule mwingine jioni inapoingia.
sw.R: Toa mmoja wao asubuhi na mwingine jioni.

vi.L: Con chiên con thứ nhất ngươi phải dâng vào buổi sáng, và con chiên con thứ hai ngươi phải dâng vào giữa hai buổi chiều.
vi.B: Một con phải được dâng vào buổi sáng, và con kia vào lúc chiều tối.
vi.R: Hãy dâng một con vào buổi sáng và một con vào buổi chiều.

ko.L: 한 어린 숫양은 아침에 바치고, 둘째 어린 숫양은 두 저녁 사이에 바쳐라.
ko.B: 어린 숫양 한 마리는 아침에 바치고, 다른 한 마리는 해 질 무렵에 바쳐라.
ko.R: 한 마리는 아침에 바치고, 다른 한 마리는 저녁에 바쳐야 한다.

pt.L: Um cordeiro oferecerás pela manhã, e o segundo cordeiro oferecerás entre as duas tardes;
pt.B: Oferecerás um cordeiro de manhã e o outro ao entardecer.
pt.R: Oferece um deles de manhã e o outro à tarde.

am.L: አንዱን ጠቦት በጠዋት ታቀርባለህ፤ ሁለተኛውንም ጠቦት በሁለቱ ምሽቶች መካከል ታቀርባለህ።
am.B: አንዱን ጠቦት በጠዋት፣ ሁለተኛውንም ምሽት ሲገባ አቅርቡ።
am.R: አንዱን በጠዋት፣ ሌላውን ደግሞ ፀሐይ ስትጠልቅ አቅርቡ።

decisions.choice: between the two evenings: at dusk, as day turns into night
decisions.reason: The same phrase sets the time of the evening lamb in Exodus 29:39 and of the Passover in Leviticus 23:5 and Numbers 9:3. It means the time when evening comes on. Its exact span is not settled; see Leviticus 23:5.

decisions.choice: you shall offer: the command now speaks to Israel as one
decisions.reason: The verbs change from "you" plural (verse 3) to "you" singular. The same people are meant, now addressed as one body, as often in these laws (15:5).

decisions.choice: as evening comes on / in the evening
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 23:5, Balanced says "as evening comes on" and Readable "in the evening". Literal keeps "between the two evenings".

decisions.choice: singular "tú" forms in verses 4-8 and 21 ("ofrecerás", "ofrece"); plural_you forms elsewhere
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes from plural to singular "you" here (meaning decision m2); Spanish follows the Hebrew number at every level, as in 15:5-10.

decisions.choice: "tu" in verses 4-8 and 21 ("tu offriras", "offre"); "vous" elsewhere in the chapter
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes from plural to singular "you" here (meaning decision m2); French follows the Hebrew number at every level, as in 15:5-10.

decisions.choice: singular forms in verses 4-8 and 21 ("utamtoa", "toa"); plural forms elsewhere ("mtatoa", "toeni")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew changes from plural to singular "you" here (meaning decision m2); Swahili follows the Hebrew number at every level.

decisions.choice: "ngươi" (singular)
decisions.reason: The verb turns to the singular, speaking to Israel as one; Literal keeps the singular as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "두 저녁 사이에" (Literal), "해 질 무렵에" (Balanced), "저녁에" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As Korean Exodus 29:39 and Leviticus 23:5; the idiom means dusk (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: oferecerás, Oferece (tu), here and in verses 7-8 and 21
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural of verse 3 to the singular, speaking to Israel as one body (m2). Portuguese can show this, as English cannot: it uses "tu", the form God uses to Israel addressed in the singular (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), wherever the Hebrew verb is singular (verses 4, 7, 8, 21) and "vocês" elsewhere. "Entre as duas tardes" (L), "ao entardecer" (B) and "à tarde" (R) follow Exodus 29:39 and the English levels.

decisions.choice: Literal follows the Hebrew's change between singular and plural "you" (here "ታቀርባለህ"); Balanced and Readable say "እናንተ" (plural) through chapters 28 and 29; "በሁለቱ ምሽቶች መካከል" (L), "ምሽት ሲገባ" (B), "ፀሐይ ስትጠልቅ" (R)
alternatives: singular at every level where the Hebrew has it
decisions.reason: The commands are for all Israel, which the Hebrew addresses now as one, now as many; in Amharic the switch would read as a change of hearer, so Balanced and Readable keep the plural. The evening phrase is as in Exodus 29:39.

source.text: וַעֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָאֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְמִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] tenth of the ephah [of] fine flour for [a] grain offering, mixed with oil, pressed, [a] fourth of the hin.

en.L: And a tenth of the ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a quarter of the hin of pressed oil.
en.B: The grain offering for each lamb is to be {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of pressed olive oil.
en.R: With each lamb, bring a grain offering of {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of the best olive oil.

es.L: Y la décima parte del efa de flor de harina para ofrenda de cereal, mezclada con la cuarta parte del hin de aceite prensado.
es.B: La ofrenda de cereal para cada cordero será de {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de flor de harina mezclada con {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de aceite de oliva prensado.
es.R: Con cada cordero, trae una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de aceite de oliva de primera calidad.

fr.L: Et un dixième de l’épha de fleur de farine en offrande végétale, mêlée à un quart du hin d’huile pressée.
fr.B: L’offrande végétale de chaque agneau sera de {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de fleur de farine mêlée à {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} d’huile d’olive pressée.
fr.R: Avec chaque agneau, apporte une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} d’huile d’olive de première qualité.

sw.L: Na sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga laini kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka, uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta ya kukamuliwa.
sw.B: Sadaka ya nafaka kwa kila mwanakondoo itakuwa unga laini {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta ya zeituni yaliyokamuliwa {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}}.
sw.R: Pamoja na kila mwanakondoo, lete sadaka ya nafaka ya unga bora kabisa {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta bora ya zeituni {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}}.

vi.L: Và một phần mười ê-pha bột mịn làm tế lễ ngũ cốc, trộn với một phần tư hin dầu ép.
vi.B: Tế lễ ngũ cốc đi kèm mỗi chiên con phải là {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} dầu ô-liu ép.
vi.R: Cùng với mỗi chiên con, hãy đem đến một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} dầu ô-liu loại tốt nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 곡식 제물로 고운 가루 십분의 일 에바에 찧어 짠 기름 사분의 일 힌을 섞어 [바쳐라].
ko.B: 어린 숫양마다 곡식 제물로 고운 가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}}에 찧어 짠 올리브기름 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 섞어 바쳐라.
ko.R: 어린 숫양 한 마리마다 곡식 제물을 함께 가져와야 한다. 고운 가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}}에 가장 좋은 올리브기름 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 섞어서 가져와야 한다.

pt.L: E um décimo do efa de flor de farinha para oferta de cereal, amassada com um quarto do him de azeite batido.
pt.B: A oferta de cereal para cada cordeiro será de {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} de flor de farinha amassada com {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de azeite de olivas batidas.
pt.R: Com cada cordeiro, tragam uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} da melhor farinha misturada com {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} do melhor azeite.

am.L: ለእህል ቁርባንም ተወቅጦ በወጣ በኢን አንድ አራተኛ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ የላመ ዱቄት።
am.B: ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የሚቀርበው የእህል ቁርባን ተወቅጦ በወጣ {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} የወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት ይሁን።
am.R: ከእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ጋር {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} ምርጥ የወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን ይቅረብ።

decisions.choice: a tenth of the ephah; a fourth of the hin: about two quarts of flour and a quart of oil
decisions.reason: The ephah was a dry measure of about twenty quarts, so a tenth of it was about two quarts. The hin was a liquid measure of about a gallon, so a quarter of it was about a quart. These are the amounts for a lamb in Exodus 29:40 and Numbers 15:4.

decisions.choice: pressed oil: the finest olive oil
decisions.reason: The word means beaten or crushed. It names oil beaten from olives, which gave the clearest oil, the kind used for the lamp (Exodus 27:20) and for the daily offering (Exodus 29:40).

decisions.choice: for a grain offering: with each of the two lambs
decisions.reason: The verse has no verb; it adds the grain offering to the lamb of verse 4. Verse 7 says "for each lamb", and verse 8 gives the evening lamb the same grain offering as the morning one, so the amounts are for each lamb.

decisions.choice: about 2 quarts; about a quart (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in 15:4, Balanced and Readable give modern measures, with the ancient ones as the alternative wording. Literal keeps "a tenth of the ephah" and "a quarter of the hin". Balanced and Readable say "for each lamb" or "with each lamb" to join the verse to verse 4, and Readable says "the best olive oil" for "pressed oil".

decisions.choice: Metric amounts by default, with the ephah and the hin as the alternative: a tenth of an ephah "khoảng 2,2 lít", two tenths "khoảng 4,4 lít", three tenths "khoảng 6,6 lít"; a quarter of a hin "khoảng 0,9 lít", a third "khoảng 1,2 lít", a half "khoảng 1,8 lít"
alternatives: US measures, as in the English
decisions.reason: Vietnamese readers measure in litres; the values follow the term sheets (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres) and the Vietnamese Leviticus. Literal keeps the original units.

decisions.choice: {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}} and {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}: metric by default, the original measure as the alternative; Literal keeps the ephah and hin
decisions.reason: Korean measures in litres where the English converts; the values are those of the Pentateuch sheets (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres), as in Korean Exodus 29:40 and Leviticus 23:13. A third of a hin is about 1.2 litres, half a hin about 1.8 litres.

decisions.choice: "찧어 짠 기름" (Literal), "찧어 짠 올리브기름" (Balanced), "가장 좋은 올리브기름" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The pressed oil is the finest olive oil (meaning decision), as in Korean Exodus 29:40.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}}; {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}}; for chapters 28-29
decisions.reason: For chapters 28-29, as Exodus 29:40 and Leviticus 23:13 set it: metric by default, the ancient measure as the alternative, where the English converts to quarts. With the ephah at 22 litros and the hin at 3,7 litros: a tenth of an ephah is 2,2 litros, two tenths 4,4 and three tenths 6,6; a quarter of a hin is "cerca de 1 litro", as Exodus rounds it, a third "cerca de 1,2 litro" and a half "cerca de 2 litros". Literal keeps "efa" and "him". "Flor de farinha" (L, B), "a melhor farinha" (R), "amassada" (L, B) and "misturada" (R) are the words of Leviticus 2:1 and 23:13; "azeite batido" is the pressed oil of Exodus 29:40 (m2).

decisions.choice: metric by default: "2.2 ሊትር ያህል" for a tenth of an ephah (two tenths 4.4, three tenths 6.6), "1 ሊትር ያህል" for a quarter of a hin (a third 1.2, a half 2); the Hebrew measure ("የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ", "የኢን አንድ አራተኛ") as the alternative
decisions.reason: Amharic gives metric measures by default with the Hebrew unit as the alternative (the English uses US units), with the values of the Pentateuch terms list (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres) and of Exodus 29:40. Literal keeps the Hebrew units.

source.text: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָעֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] burnt offering of continuity, the [one] made at [the] mountain of Sinai for [an] aroma of soothing, [an] offering by fire to Yahweh.

en.L: [It is] a continual burnt offering, the one made at Mount Sinai, for an aroma of soothing, an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: It is the regular burnt offering, as it was offered at Mount Sinai: a soothing aroma, a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: This is the daily burnt offering that was first offered at Mount Sinai. It is a food offering burned on the altar, and its smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: [Es] un holocausto continuo, el que se hizo en el monte Sinaí, como aroma grato, ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Es el holocausto regular, tal como se ofreció en el monte Sinaí: aroma grato, ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Este es el holocausto diario que se ofreció por primera vez en el monte Sinaí. Es una ofrenda quemada en el altar, y su olor es agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: [C’est] un holocauste continuel, celui qui a été fait au mont Sinaï, en odeur apaisante, offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: C’est l’holocauste régulier, tel qu’il a été offert au mont Sinaï : une odeur apaisante, une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: C’est l’holocauste quotidien qui a été offert pour la première fois au mont Sinaï. C’est une offrande brûlée sur l’autel, et son odeur plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: [Ni] sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya daima, ile iliyofanywa katika mlima Sinai, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku, kama ilivyotolewa katika mlima Sinai: harufu ya kupendeza, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo sadaka ya kuteketezwa ya kila siku iliyotolewa kwa mara ya kwanza katika mlima Sinai. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto juu ya madhabahu, na harufu yake inampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: [Đó là] của lễ thiêu thường xuyên, là [của lễ] đã được dâng tại núi Si-na-i, làm hương thơm làm đẹp lòng, một của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đó là của lễ thiêu thường xuyên, như đã được dâng tại núi Si-na-i, một hương thơm làm đẹp lòng, một của lễ dâng bằng lửa cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đây là của lễ thiêu hằng ngày đã được dâng lần đầu tại núi Si-na-i. Đó là của lễ dâng bằng lửa trên bàn thờ, và mùi thơm của nó làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: [이것은] 시내 산에서 드리던 늘 드리는 번제로, 향기로운 냄새, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물이다.
ko.B: 이것은 시내 산에서 바치던 것과 같은 늘 드리는 번제이며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물이요 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.R: 이것은 시내 산에서 처음 바치기 시작한 날마다 드리는 번제이다. 이것은 제단에서 불로 태워 바치는 제물이며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기가 된다.

pt.L: [É] um holocausto contínuo, o que foi feito no monte Sinai, como aroma agradável, oferta queimada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: É o holocausto contínuo, como foi oferecido no monte Sinai: aroma agradável, uma oferta queimada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Esse é o holocausto diário que foi oferecido pela primeira vez no monte Sinai. É uma oferta queimada no fogo, e o seu cheiro agrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: [ይህ] በሲና ተራራ የተደረገው፣ ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ እንዲሆን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት የሆነው የዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት [ነው]።
am.B: ይህ በሲና ተራራ እንደ ቀረበው ያለ የዘወትሩ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ ያለው፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ነው።
am.R: ይህ በመጀመሪያ በሲና ተራራ የቀረበው ዕለታዊው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው። በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ነው፤ መዓዛውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል።

decisions.choice: the one made at Mount Sinai: the daily offering began at Sinai
decisions.reason: The daily offering was commanded at Sinai (Exodus 29:38-42) and began when the priests started their work there (Leviticus 9:17). The new generation is to go on with the same offering their parents brought at the mountain.

decisions.choice: made: offered at Sinai, not only commanded there
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for offering the lambs in verse 4, so it most likely means the offering that was brought at Sinai. It could also mean the offering that was set up or ordained there. The difference is small: either way the daily offering goes back to Sinai.

decisions.choice: [It is]
decisions.reason: The verse has no verb in Hebrew. Literal brackets "It is"; Balanced and Readable say it without brackets. Readable adds "first" to show that the offering began at Sinai and goes on.

source.text: וְנִסְכּוֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַהִ֔ין לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד בַּקֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And its drink offering [is] [a] fourth of the hin for the lamb, the one; in the holy place pour out [a] drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh.

en.L: And its drink offering [shall be] a quarter of the hin for each lamb; in the holy place pour out a drink offering of strong drink to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Its drink offering is to be {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} for each lamb. In the holy place pour out the drink offering of strong drink to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: For each lamb, also bring {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of strong drink as a drink offering. Pour it out for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the holy place.

es.L: Y su libación [será] la cuarta parte del hin para cada cordero; en el lugar santo derrama una libación de bebida fuerte {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Su libación será de {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} para cada cordero. En el lugar santo derrama la libación de bebida fuerte {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por cada cordero, trae también {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de bebida fuerte como ofrenda. Derrámala para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en el lugar santo.

fr.L: Et sa libation [sera] d’un quart du hin pour chaque agneau ; dans le lieu saint, verse une libation de boisson forte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Sa libation sera de {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} pour chaque agneau. Dans le lieu saint, verse la libation de boisson forte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Pour chaque agneau, apporte aussi {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} de boisson forte en offrande. Verse-la pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans le lieu saint.

sw.L: Na sadaka yake ya kinywaji [itakuwa] robo ya hini kwa kila mwanakondoo; katika mahali patakatifu mimina sadaka ya kinywaji ya kileo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Sadaka yake ya kinywaji itakuwa {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}} kwa kila mwanakondoo. Katika mahali patakatifu mimina sadaka ya kinywaji ya kileo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa kila mwanakondoo, lete pia kileo {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}} kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji. Kimimine kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika mahali patakatifu.

vi.L: Và lễ quán của nó [phải là] một phần tư hin cho mỗi chiên con; hãy rưới lễ quán bằng rượu mạnh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại nơi thánh.
vi.B: Lễ quán đi kèm phải là {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} cho mỗi chiên con. Hãy rưới lễ quán bằng rượu mạnh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại nơi thánh.
vi.R: Với mỗi chiên con, cũng hãy đem đến {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} rượu mạnh làm lễ quán. Hãy rưới rượu ấy ra cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại nơi thánh.

ko.L: 그리고 그것의 부어 드리는 제물은 어린 숫양 한 마리에 사분의 일 힌이다. 너는 성소에서 독한 술을 부어 드리는 제물로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부어 드려라.
ko.B: 그와 함께 바칠 부어 드리는 제물은 어린 숫양 한 마리마다 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}이다. 성소에서 독한 술을 부어 드리는 제물로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부어 드려라.
ko.R: 어린 숫양 한 마리마다 독한 술 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 부어 드리는 제물로 가져와야 한다. 그것을 성소에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부어 드려야 한다.

pt.L: E a sua oferta de bebida [será] um quarto do him para cada cordeiro; no lugar santo derrama oferta de bebida de bebida forte {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: A oferta de bebida será de {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} para cada cordeiro. No lugar santo, derrama {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a oferta de bebida forte.
pt.R: Para cada cordeiro, traz também {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de bebida forte como oferta de bebida. Derrama essa bebida {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} no lugar santo.

am.L: የመጠጥ ቁርባኑም ለአንዱ ጠቦት የኢን አንድ አራተኛ [ይሁን]፤ በቅዱሱ ስፍራ የሚያሰክር መጠጥ የመጠጥ ቁርባን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አፍስስ።
am.B: የመጠጥ ቁርባኑ ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} ይሁን። የሚያሰክረውን መጠጥ የመጠጥ ቁርባን አድርጋችሁ በቅዱሱ ስፍራ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አፍስሱ።
am.R: ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ደግሞ {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} የሚያሰክር መጠጥ የመጠጥ ቁርባን አድርጋችሁ አምጡ። በቅዱሱ ስፍራ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} አፍስሱት።

decisions.choice: strong drink: here, the strong wine of the drink offering
decisions.reason: The word names a fermented drink stronger than ordinary wine, and is often paired with wine (Leviticus 10:9; Numbers 6:3). Elsewhere the drink offering is of wine (15:5; Exodus 29:40), and verse 14 says "wine", so here the word probably means strong wine. It may instead mean that another fermented drink could be used.

decisions.choice: in the holy place: at the altar in the court of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: "The holy place" here means the sanctuary area. The drink offering was not poured on the incense altar inside the tent (Exodus 30:9), so it was poured out at the altar of burnt offering, where the lamb was burned.

decisions.choice: for each lamb: each of the two lambs has its drink offering
decisions.reason: "The one lamb" means each lamb, as in 15:5. For the drink offering see 15:5.

decisions.choice: strong drink
decisions.reason: All three levels keep "strong drink", so that the reader can see that the word differs from the "wine" of verse 14. The meaning decision explains it.

decisions.choice: bebida fuerte (all levels); at Readable "ofrenda de vino" for the drink offering elsewhere, as in chapter 29
decisions.reason: Here the word most likely means strong wine (meaning decision m1). All levels keep a word distinct from the "vino" of verse 14; "cerveza", used in Leviticus 10:9, would name a different drink here.

decisions.choice: boisson forte (all levels); at Readable "offrande de vin" for the drink offering elsewhere, as in chapter 29
decisions.reason: Here the word most likely means strong wine (meaning decision m1). All levels keep a word distinct from the "vin" of verse 14, as the English does; "bière", used for this word in Leviticus 10:9, would name a different drink here.

decisions.choice: kileo (all levels)
decisions.reason: Here the word most likely means strong wine (meaning decision m1). "Kileo" keeps it distinct from the "divai" of verse 14 without naming a particular drink; "pombe", used at Balanced and Readable in Leviticus 10:9, suggests beer.

decisions.choice: "rượu mạnh"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one for strong drink (as Leviticus 10:9); the meaning decision's footnote explains it here as strong wine.

decisions.choice: "독한 술" for "strong drink"; "부어 드리는 제물" for the drink offering
decisions.reason: The meaning decision takes it as the strong wine of the drink offering; "독한 술" is the plain modern phrase. The drink offering is described rather than given the older term "전제", as in Korean Exodus and Leviticus.

decisions.choice: bebida forte (every level)
decisions.reason: As the English keeps "strong drink" at every level (r-en-1), Portuguese keeps "bebida forte", the word Leviticus 10:9 and Numbers 6:3 use in Portuguese, so the reader can see that it differs from the "vinho" of verse 14 (m1). "Oferta de bebida" is the name Leviticus 23:13 sets. The verb "pour out" is singular in the Hebrew, so "derrama" (tu), as verse 4 explains.

decisions.choice: "የሚያሰክር መጠጥ" (strong drink)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names strong drink in general; "ጠጅ" would name the Ethiopian honey wine, and "የወይን ጠጅ" is kept for the word "wine" in verse 14.

source.text: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the lamb, the second, you will offer between the evenings; like [the] grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you will offer, [an] offering by fire, [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: And the second lamb you shall offer between the two evenings; like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you shall offer [it], an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The second lamb you are to offer as evening comes on, with a grain offering and a drink offering like those of the morning: a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Offer the other lamb in the evening, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is a food offering burned on the altar, and its smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el segundo cordero lo ofrecerás entre las dos tardes; como la ofrenda de cereal de la mañana y como su libación lo ofrecerás, ofrenda quemada, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: El segundo cordero lo ofrecerás al caer la tarde, con una ofrenda de cereal y una libación como las de la mañana: ofrenda quemada, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Ofrece el otro cordero por la tarde, con la misma ofrenda de cereal y la misma ofrenda de vino que por la mañana. Es una ofrenda quemada en el altar, y su olor es agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le second agneau, tu l’offriras entre les deux soirs ; comme l’offrande végétale du matin et comme sa libation, tu [l’]offriras, offrande consumée par le feu, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu offriras le second agneau à la tombée du soir, avec une offrande végétale et une libation semblables à celles du matin : c’est une offrande consumée par le feu, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Offre l’autre agneau le soir, avec la même offrande végétale et la même offrande de vin que le matin. C’est une offrande brûlée sur l’autel, et son odeur plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na mwanakondoo wa pili utamtoa kati ya jioni mbili; kama sadaka ya nafaka ya asubuhi na kama sadaka yake ya kinywaji utamtoa, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mwanakondoo wa pili utamtoa jioni inapoingia, pamoja na sadaka ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kama zile za asubuhi: sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Toa mwanakondoo yule mwingine jioni, pamoja na sadaka ile ile ya nafaka na sadaka ya kinywaji kama za asubuhi. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto juu ya madhabahu, na harufu yake inampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và con chiên con thứ hai ngươi phải dâng vào giữa hai buổi chiều; như tế lễ ngũ cốc buổi sáng và như lễ quán của nó, ngươi phải dâng [nó], một của lễ dâng bằng lửa, hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Con chiên con thứ hai phải được dâng vào lúc chiều tối, kèm theo tế lễ ngũ cốc và lễ quán giống như buổi sáng. Đó là của lễ dâng bằng lửa, một hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy dâng con chiên con kia vào buổi chiều, cùng với tế lễ ngũ cốc và lễ quán giống như buổi sáng. Đó là của lễ dâng bằng lửa trên bàn thờ, và mùi thơm của nó làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 둘째 어린 숫양은 두 저녁 사이에 바치되, 아침의 곡식 제물과 그것의 부어 드리는 제물처럼 바쳐라. [그것은] 불로 바치는 제물이요, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.B: 다른 어린 숫양은 해 질 무렵에 바치되, 아침과 같은 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물을 함께 바쳐라. 그것은 불로 바치는 제물이요, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.R: 다른 어린 숫양은 저녁에 바쳐야 한다. 아침에 바친 것과 같은 곡식 제물과 부어 드리는 제물도 함께 바쳐야 한다. 그것은 제단에서 불로 태워 바치는 제물이며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기가 된다.

pt.L: E o segundo cordeiro oferecerás entre as duas tardes; como a oferta de cereal da manhã e como a sua oferta de bebida [o] oferecerás, oferta queimada, aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: O segundo cordeiro oferecerás ao entardecer, com uma oferta de cereal e uma oferta de bebida iguais às da manhã: uma oferta queimada, de aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Oferece o outro cordeiro à tarde, com a mesma oferta de cereal e a mesma oferta de bebida da manhã. É uma oferta queimada no fogo, e o seu cheiro agrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ሁለተኛውንም ጠቦት በሁለቱ ምሽቶች መካከል ታቀርባለህ፤ እንደ ጠዋቱ የእህል ቁርባንና እንደ መጠጥ ቁርባኑ ታቀርበዋለህ፤ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ ነው።
am.B: ሁለተኛውን ጠቦት ምሽት ሲገባ አቅርቡ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር እንደ ጠዋቱ ያለ የእህል ቁርባንና የመጠጥ ቁርባን አቅርቡ፤ ይህ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ ነው።
am.R: ሌላውን ጠቦት ፀሐይ ስትጠልቅ አቅርቡ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር በጠዋት ያቀረባችሁትን የመሰለ የእህል ቁርባንና የመጠጥ ቁርባን አቅርቡ። ይህ በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ነው፤ መዓዛውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል።

decisions.choice: like the grain offering of the morning: the same amounts as verses 5 and 7
decisions.reason: The evening lamb has the same grain offering and drink offering as the morning lamb. For "between the two evenings" see verse 4.

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: as in verse 2
decisions.reason: The daily offering, morning and evening, is a gift the LORD gladly accepts.

source.text: וּבְיוֹם֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי־כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן וְנִסְכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And on [the] day of the sabbath two lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, and two tenths [of] fine flour [as a] grain offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering,

en.L: And on the sabbath day, two male lambs, sons of a year, unblemished, and two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour [as] a grain offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering,
en.B: On the Sabbath day there are to be two year-old male lambs without defect, with {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and its drink offering,
en.R: On the Sabbath day, offer two male lambs one year old, with nothing wrong with them. With them bring a grain offering of {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with olive oil, and the drink offering that goes with it.

es.L: Y el día del sábado, dos corderos de un año, sin defecto, y dos décimos [de efa] de flor de harina [como] ofrenda de cereal mezclada con aceite, y su libación,
es.B: El día del sábado habrá dos corderos de un año, sin defecto, con {{units:unos 4 litros|dos décimas partes de un efa}} de flor de harina mezclada con aceite como ofrenda de cereal, y su libación,
es.R: El día del sábado, {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofreced}} dos corderos de un año, que no tengan ningún defecto. Con ellos {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 4 litros|dos décimas partes de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con aceite de oliva, y la ofrenda de vino que la acompaña.

fr.L: Et le jour du sabbat, deux agneaux d’un an, sans défaut, et deux dixièmes [d’épha] de fleur de farine [en] offrande végétale mêlée à l’huile, et sa libation,
fr.B: Le jour du sabbat, il y aura deux agneaux d’un an, sans défaut, avec {{units:environ 4 litres|deux dixièmes d’épha}} de fleur de farine mêlée à l’huile en offrande végétale, et sa libation,
fr.R: Le jour du sabbat, offrez deux agneaux d’un an, sans aucun défaut. Avec eux, apportez une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 4 litres|deux dixièmes d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec de l’huile d’olive, et l’offrande de vin qui l’accompagne.

sw.L: Na siku ya Sabato, wanakondoo dume wawili, wana wa mwaka mmoja, wasio na kasoro, na sehemu mbili za kumi [za efa] za unga laini [kuwa] sadaka ya nafaka iliyochanganywa na mafuta, na sadaka yake ya kinywaji,
sw.B: Siku ya Sabato kutakuwa na wanakondoo dume wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na kasoro, pamoja na unga laini {{units:kama lita 4|sehemu mbili za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta kuwa sadaka ya nafaka, na sadaka yake ya kinywaji,
sw.R: Siku ya Sabato, toeni wanakondoo dume wawili wa mwaka mmoja wasio na kasoro yoyote. Pamoja nao leteni sadaka ya nafaka ya unga bora kabisa {{units:kama lita 4|sehemu mbili za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta ya zeituni, na sadaka ya kinywaji inayoandamana nayo.

vi.L: Và vào ngày Sa-bát, hai chiên con đực một tuổi, không tì vết, và hai phần mười [ê-pha] bột mịn [làm] tế lễ ngũ cốc trộn với dầu, và lễ quán của nó,
vi.B: Vào ngày Sa-bát, phải dâng hai chiên con đực một tuổi không tì vết, cùng với {{units:khoảng 4,4 lít|hai phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với dầu làm tế lễ ngũ cốc, và lễ quán đi kèm,
vi.R: Vào ngày Sa-bát, hãy dâng hai chiên con đực một tuổi, không có tật gì. Cùng với chúng, hãy đem đến một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 4,4 lít|hai phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với dầu ô-liu, và lễ quán đi kèm.

ko.L: 그리고 안식일에는 흠 없는 일 년 된 어린 숫양 두 마리와, 곡식 제물로 기름 섞은 고운 가루 십분의 이 [에바]와, 그것의 부어 드리는 제물을 [바쳐라].
ko.B: 안식일에는 일 년 된 흠 없는 어린 숫양 두 마리를 바치고, 기름을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 4.4리터|십분의 이 에바}}을 곡식 제물로, 거기에 딸린 부어 드리는 제물과 함께 바쳐라.
ko.R: 안식일에는 일 년 된 어린 숫양 두 마리를 바쳐야 한다. 그 양들은 흠이 없어야 한다. 그와 함께 고운 가루 {{units:약 4.4리터|십분의 이 에바}}에 올리브기름을 섞어서 곡식 제물로 가져오고, 거기에 딸린 부어 드리는 제물도 가져와야 한다.

pt.L: E no dia de sábado, dois cordeiros, filhos de um ano, sem defeito, e dois décimos [de efa] de flor de farinha [como] oferta de cereal amassada com azeite, e a sua oferta de bebida,
pt.B: No dia de sábado, haverá dois cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito, com {{units:cerca de 4,4 litros|dois décimos de efa}} de flor de farinha amassada com azeite como oferta de cereal, e a sua oferta de bebida,
pt.R: No dia de sábado, ofereçam dois cordeiros machos de um ano, sem nenhum defeito. Com eles, tragam uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 4,4 litros|dois décimos de efa}} da melhor farinha misturada com azeite, e a oferta de bebida que a acompanha.

am.L: በሰንበትም ቀን የዓመት ልጆች የሆኑ ነውር የሌለባቸው ሁለት ጠቦቶች፣ ለእህል ቁርባንም በዘይት የተለወሰ የ[ኢፍ] ሁለት አሥረኛ የላመ ዱቄት፣ የመጠጥ ቁርባኑም፤
am.B: በሰንበት ቀን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸው ነውር የሌለባቸው ሁለት ተባዕት ጠቦቶች፣ ለእህል ቁርባንም በዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:4.4 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሁለት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት፣ የመጠጥ ቁርባኑም ይቅረቡ፤
am.R: በሰንበት ቀን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን ምንም ጉድለት የሌለባቸውን ሁለት ተባዕት ጠቦቶች አቅርቡ። ከእነርሱም ጋር በወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:4.4 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሁለት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን፣ ከእርሱም ጋር የሚሄደውን የመጠጥ ቁርባን አምጡ።

decisions.choice: on the sabbath day: two more lambs, doubling the daily offering
decisions.reason: On the Sabbath, the seventh day of every week (Leviticus 23:3), two lambs are added to the two of the daily offering. The Sabbath is set apart by the offering as well as by rest.

decisions.choice: two tenths ... and its drink offering: one grain offering for the two lambs
decisions.reason: The two tenths of flour, about four quarts, are the grain offering for both lambs together, a tenth for each as in verse 5. The amount of the drink offering is not given; it is probably a quarter of a hin for each lamb, as in verse 7. The verse has no verb, and the sentence ends in verse 10.

decisions.choice: about 4 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 5. Literal brackets "of an ephah", which the Hebrew leaves out. Balanced supplies "there are to be" and Readable "offer", since the verse has no verb.

decisions.choice: o dia de sábado
decisions.reason: "Sábado" is lowercase at every level, like the days of the week, as Leviticus 23:3 writes it in Portuguese, where the English Balanced and Readable capitalise "Sabbath".

source.text: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּשַׁבַּתּ֑וֹ עַל־עֹלַ֥ת הַתָּמִ֖יד וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [the] burnt offering of sabbath in its sabbath, besides [the] burnt offering of the continuity and its drink offering.

en.L: the burnt offering of [every] sabbath on its sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
en.B: as the burnt offering of each Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
en.R: This is the burnt offering for each Sabbath. Offer it in addition to the daily burnt offering and its drink offering.

es.L: el holocausto de [cada] sábado en su sábado, además del holocausto continuo y su libación.
es.B: como holocausto de cada sábado, además del holocausto regular y su libación.
es.R: Este es el holocausto de cada sábado. {{plural_you:Ofrézcanlo|Ofrecedlo}} además del holocausto diario y su ofrenda de vino.

fr.L: l’holocauste de [chaque] sabbat en son sabbat, en plus de l’holocauste continuel et de sa libation.
fr.B: comme holocauste de chaque sabbat, en plus de l’holocauste régulier et de sa libation.
fr.R: C’est l’holocauste de chaque sabbat. Offrez-le en plus de l’holocauste quotidien et de son offrande de vin.

decisions.choice: the burnt offering of sabbath on its sabbath: the offering for every Sabbath
decisions.reason: Repeating the word with "its" means each one in turn: the offering is brought on every Sabbath, week after week. Verse 14 says the same of the months.

decisions.choice: besides the continual burnt offering: added to the daily offering, not in place of it
decisions.reason: The word means "on top of". The Sabbath offering is brought as well as the two daily lambs, never instead of them. The same rule is repeated for each day in the calendar (verses 15, 23, 24, 31).

decisions.choice: [every]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets "every" to show the sense of the repeated word. Balanced and Readable say "each Sabbath".

records.literal_gloss: And at [the] beginnings of your months you will present [a] burnt offering to Yahweh: bulls, sons of [the] herd, two, and ram, one, lambs, sons of a year, seven, unblemished.

en.L: And at the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: two bulls, young ones of the herd, and one ram, seven male lambs, sons of a year, unblemished.
en.B: Each month, on its first day, you are to bring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a burnt offering: two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs in their first year, every one of them without defect.
en.R: When each new month begins, bring a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Bring two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. None of them may have anything wrong with it.

es.L: Y en los comienzos de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} meses {{plural_you:presentarán|presentaréis}} un holocausto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: dos toros, jóvenes de la vacada, y un carnero, siete corderos de un año, sin defecto.
es.B: Cada mes, en su primer día, {{plural_you:ofrecerán|ofreceréis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un holocausto: dos novillos, un carnero y siete corderos de un año, todos sin defecto.
es.R: Cuando empiece cada mes nuevo, {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} un holocausto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Traigan|Traed}} dos novillos, un carnero y siete corderos de un año. Ninguno de ellos debe tener ningún defecto.

fr.L: Et aux commencements de vos mois, vous présenterez un holocauste {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : deux taureaux, jeunes du gros bétail, et un bélier, sept agneaux d’un an, sans défaut.
fr.B: Chaque mois, le premier jour, vous offrirez un holocauste {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : deux jeunes taureaux, un bélier et sept agneaux d’un an, tous sans défaut.
fr.R: Quand commence chaque nouveau mois, apportez un holocauste {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Apportez deux jeunes taureaux, un bélier et sept agneaux d’un an. Aucun d’eux ne doit avoir de défaut.

sw.L: Na katika mwanzo wa miezi yenu mtamsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya kuteketezwa: fahali wawili, wachanga wa kundi la ng'ombe, na kondoo dume mmoja, wanakondoo dume saba, wana wa mwaka mmoja, wasio na kasoro.
sw.B: Kila mwezi, siku yake ya kwanza, mtamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya kuteketezwa: fahali wachanga wawili, kondoo dume mmoja na wanakondoo dume saba wa mwaka mmoja, wote wasio na kasoro.

am.L: በወሮቻችሁም መጀመሪያዎች {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ከከብት መንጋ የሆኑ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፣ አንድ አውራ በግ፣ የዓመት ልጆች የሆኑ ነውር የሌለባቸው ሰባት ጠቦቶች።

am.R: አዲስ ወር በጀመረ ቁጥር {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አምጡ። ሁለት ወይፈኖች፣ አንድ አውራ በግና አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸው ሰባት ተባዕት ጠቦቶች አምጡ። ከእነዚህ አንዳቸውም ምንም ጉድለት ሊኖርባቸው አይገባም።

decisions.choice: the beginnings of your months: the new moon, the first day of each month
decisions.reason: Israel's months followed the moon, and each began when the new moon first appeared. The day was marked with trumpets as well as offerings (10:10), and was a day of rest from trade in later times (Amos 8:5).

decisions.choice: two bulls, one ram, seven lambs: the larger set of festival offerings
decisions.reason: The new moon has the same burnt offerings as each day of Unleavened Bread (verse 19) and the day of firstfruits (verse 27): far more than the two lambs of the Sabbath. Seven lambs, the number of completeness, run through the festival lists.

decisions.choice: unblemished: all the animals, not the lambs only
decisions.reason: The word stands at the end of the list after the lambs, but it applies to every animal: all offerings had to be without defect (Leviticus 22:19-21), and verses 19 and 31 say so of the whole set.

decisions.choice: on its first day / when each new month begins
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the beginnings of your months". Balanced ("on its first day") and Readable ("when each new month begins") say what the phrase means, as at 10:10.

decisions.choice: "bò đực tơ"
decisions.reason: A young bull "of the herd"; the Vietnamese Leviticus uses "bò đực tơ", and Literal adds "trong bầy" for "son of the herd".

decisions.choice: "너희 달들의 첫날" (Literal), "초하루" (Balanced), "새 달이 시작되는 날" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The first day of each month, the new moon (meaning decision); "초하루" is the word Korean Chronicles uses for the new-moon day.

decisions.choice: nos começos dos seus meses (L); no primeiro dia de cada mês (B); no início de cada mês, na lua nova (R); a lua nova (B, verse 14), o início de cada mês (R, verse 14)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the day is the new moon that begins each month (m1). Literal keeps "nos começos dos seus meses", as 10:10 does, and Balanced says "no primeiro dia de cada mês", also as there; Readable says "no início de cada mês" and adds "na lua nova", which the meaning note gives, so readers know why the month begins then. In verse 14 Balanced names the day "a lua nova" where the English Balanced says "new moon", and Readable "o início de cada mês".

decisions.choice: dois novilhos, filhos do gado (L), dois novilhos (B, R); todos sem defeito (B); Todos devem estar sem nenhum defeito (R)
decisions.reason: For chapters 28-29: "novilho" is the young bull of the offerings, as Leviticus 4:3 and 23:18 say; Literal adds "filhos do gado" for the Hebrew "sons of the herd" as Leviticus 4:3 does, and Balanced and Readable fold it into "novilho", as the English folds it into "young bull". "Without defect" covers every animal (m3): Balanced says "todos sem defeito", and Readable "Todos devem estar sem nenhum defeito", the sentence repeated through the festival lists.

decisions.choice: "ወይፈን" (young bull) for "bull, son of the herd", with "ከከብት መንጋ የሆኑ" at Literal; "አውራ በግ" (ram); "አውራ ፍየል" (male goat); the new moon "የወር መባቻ"
decisions.reason: "ወይፈን" is a young bull, which is what "son of the herd" means; "በሬ" is a grown ox, usually a draught animal. These names hold through the feast lists of chapters 28 and 29.

source.text: וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לַפָּ֖ר הָאֶחָ֑ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן לָאַ֖יִל הָֽאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And three tenths [of] fine flour [as a] grain offering mixed with oil for the bull, the one, and two tenths [of] fine flour [as a] grain offering mixed with oil for the ram, the one,

en.B: The grain offering for each bull is to be {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with oil, and for the ram {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with oil,
en.R: For each bull, bring a grain offering of {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with olive oil. For the ram, bring a grain offering of {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with olive oil.

Por el carnero, {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 4 litros|dos décimas partes de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con aceite de oliva.

fr.L: et trois dixièmes [d’épha] de fleur de farine [en] offrande végétale mêlée à l’huile pour chaque taureau, et deux dixièmes [d’épha] de fleur de farine [en] offrande végétale mêlée à l’huile pour l’unique bélier,

Pour le bélier, apportez une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 4 litres|deux dixièmes d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec de l’huile d’olive.
